catalog-store.name: catalog-store
catalog-store.description: Searchable store with generated product images, HTMX fragments, an in-memory cart, mock checkout, and an API that start --with-processes can start and stop with the site.

development-hooks-demo.name: development-hooks-demo
development-hooks-demo.description: One command prepares data, starts a Python API, waits for readiness, serves a page, verifies its API data, and stops the API on exit.

esbuild-demo.name: esbuild-demo
esbuild-demo.description: Native esbuild example with TypeScript and CSS imports, copied assets, source maps, fingerprinted output, caching, and development watching.

goja-render-demo.name: goja-render-demo
goja-render-demo.description: Server-side calculations with goja_render, including query validation, resource scripts, request isolation, and development reload behavior.

hello-world.name: hello-world
hello-world.description: Minimal YAML starter with one Hello World route and no external dependencies.

hyperbricks-patterns-yaml.name: hyperbricks-patterns-yaml
hyperbricks-patterns-yaml.description: Runnable patterns for page and fragment composition, menus, section rails, guards, API actions, plugins, HTMX, Unpoly, and rendered Markdown documentation.

navigation-demo-swup.name: navigation-demo-swup
navigation-demo-swup.description: Text-only neighbourhood guide whose complete server-rendered pages use Swup for animated navigation and browser-history transitions.

neon-pong.name: neon-pong
neon-pong.description: Self-contained arcade Pong game with solo and two-player modes, drone bonuses, synthesized sound, and native esbuild assets.

sampleapis-coffee-static.name: sampleapis-coffee-static
sampleapis-coffee-static.description: Static snapshot example that fetches the public SampleAPIs coffee endpoint through nested api_render and exports the rendered result.

spaces-image-demo.name: spaces-image-demo
spaces-image-demo.description: Two editable Spaces with inherited native images, resource-original selection and uploads, preserved resizing, and explicit nested text properties.

streaming-demo.name: streaming-demo
streaming-demo.description: Native Go plugin example that streams several HTML progress updates over one response while HTMX swaps the target as chunks arrive.

todo-demo-htmx.name: todo-demo-htmx
todo-demo-htmx.description: The Little List todo application using HTMX 4 fragment updates and browser localStorage.

todo-demo-swup.name: todo-demo-swup
todo-demo-swup.description: The same Little List application adapted to Swup, making its navigation and update model directly comparable with the other todo demos.

todo-demo-turbo.name: todo-demo-turbo
todo-demo-turbo.description: The same Little List application adapted to Hotwire Turbo.

todo-demo-unpoly.name: todo-demo-unpoly
todo-demo-unpoly.description: The same Little List application adapted to Unpoly.

unpoly-guard-demo.name: unpoly-guard-demo
unpoly-guard-demo.description: Protected full-page and fragment routes with an application-owned authentication plugin and Unpoly-enhanced navigation.
